items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I know that Trump played there too. Bright Boy. Used to play with us down there at the Lutches.

ctx.x: He was a little scared of chocolate and bite me every minute like that. Did you ever hear the name Game Kid? Huh? Game Kid? Game Kid? Uh-huh. Josuke Adams?

I know that Trump played there too. Bright Boy. Used to play with us down there at the Lutches. What? Pete. Huh? Pete. Pete. Pete. No, not Pete. I never did play with Pete. I know Pete. I used to go to Pete's house and collect the I-
